scope: User-authorized existing-data control-variate test; no MC or archive changes
cohort: Same64 chains/32 coordinates and9600 postcut configurations as latest-spin-correlations.json
coefficient: Raw configuration Cov(G,m2CP)/Var(m2CP) from the other start. Prespecified heuristic, not necessarily mean-estimator variance optimum.
uncertainty: Joint augmented moments [Gquarter,Ghalf,m2dense,S0dense,Fdense,winding2,m2CP,Gquarter*m2CP,Ghalf*m2CP,m2CP²] in100-cycle bins. Independently resample physical time blocks within starts, refit both cross-coefficients on every draw. Original and corrected share the same draws. Dense m2 mean is estimated, not known.
blocks: Max frozen previous width and corrected-series full/late-half autocorrelation width, same rule applied to matched original and corrected estimators.
evaluation: Raw unlogged paired finite estimator SD ratios before positivity/root filtering. Preserve negative CV means and singular training failures. Compare finite-pair quotients on shared valid draws, with own and common validity fractions and crossing multiplicity.
crossings: Existing linear/PCHIP interpolation, narrow/full windows, pairs24:48 and32:64 unchanged. Quarter/half separate and correlated.
limitations: Stationarity and independent starts assumed; original flags retained.
2000 bootstrap draws are not2000 independent MC experiments.
Few time blocks limit gain assessment.
No forcing known CFT exponent, no calibrated systematic-error claim.
tests: 35 focused tests passed before data analysis
